name: SCOA Pharmaceutical Blister Image Dataset
description: This dataset contains 8,532 JPEG image files associated with the study “Structure-Constrained Optical Augmentation for Pharmaceutical Blister Defect Detection”. The images depict pharmaceutical blister packaging. The study distinguishes four classes: medicine, empty, broke and lack. Medicine denotes normal tablets in undamaged packaging; empty denotes intact empty cavities; broke denotes damaged packaging without tablets; and lack denotes damaged packaging with tablets. This deposit contains image files only. Bounding-box annotations, train/validation/test split manifests and underlying non-image experimental records are not included. The images are provided for research on pharmaceutical blister inspection, computer vision and optical augmentation. Related code: https://github.com/nanxing2138/SCOA-Blister-Detection
